note: Export side is factually confirmed, not merely declared: dated India customs shipping-bill records with B/L numbers, HS codes and destinations (Qatar, Vietnam, Sri Lanka, Pakistan) from Malanpur ICD and Dadri ICD, latest 2026-02-27, 241 records on the Limited page. HS note: declared codes 040210/040221/040310/040390 are close to but not identical to the observed codes — actual shipments show 04021010 (skimmed milk powder) and 04059090 (anhydrous milk fat, which is NOT in the declared list); the declared 040310/040390 (yoghurt/buttermilk) codes were not observed in any row seen. Per project rule 3 this is not a rejection ground; the factual code set should be recorded as 04021010 + 04059090 (plus 040221 likely for the SMP variants). Domestic supply evidence is genuinely missing, not negative — status unknown, not 'none_found'. Two similarly named pages exist ("...LTD" at Malanpur/Bhind and "...LIMITED" at Pitampura, Delhi); they may be the same group's plant and registered office, but this was not verified, so treat the 241-record figure as belonging to the Pitampura-registered entity.
